# Model evaluation report (generated by train.py)

- Rows: 1364; classes: 14; near-duplicate groups: 424
- scikit-learn 1.9.1; seed 42; model version 1.0
- Short-fragment training augmentation: ON (experiment)
- Input = raw `symptom_description` text only. Leaky columns are not used.
- NOT clinically validated. Scores come from a small, templated, probably synthetic dataset.
- 'full' = original long descriptions; 'short' = 1-3 clause fragments cut from descriptions (a stand-in for brief user input, NOT real user text).

## Split

- Development rows: 1073; held-out test rows: 291 (no shared near-duplicate group)
- Classes missing from test set: none

## Model comparison (grouped stratified 5-fold CV on development set, macro-F1)

| model              |   f1_full |   f1_short |   f1_short_std |   mean(full, short) |
|:-------------------|----------:|-----------:|---------------:|--------------------:|
| LogReg C=10        |    0.9687 |     0.7683 |         0.0213 |              0.8685 |
| LinearSVC C=0.3    |    0.9619 |     0.772  |         0.0134 |              0.8669 |
| LogReg C=100       |    0.9697 |     0.7596 |         0.0225 |              0.8646 |
| LinearSVC C=1      |    0.9611 |     0.7631 |         0.0224 |              0.8621 |
| LogReg C=1         |    0.9559 |     0.7618 |         0.0181 |              0.8588 |
| ComplementNB a=0.1 |    0.9352 |     0.7549 |         0.0341 |              0.8451 |
| ComplementNB a=0.5 |    0.9286 |     0.7349 |         0.0389 |              0.8317 |

Selected: **LogReg C=10** (highest mean of full and short macro-F1). Candidates within one standard deviation are statistically indistinguishable.

## Calibration (out-of-fold, development set)

- full: accuracy 0.951; macro-F1 0.955; ECE 0.239; Brier 0.167
- short: accuracy 0.768; macro-F1 0.770; ECE 0.165; Brier 0.369

## Abstention threshold

- Chosen on short-fragment out-of-fold predictions: smallest threshold with selective accuracy >= 90% -> **0.48**
  - threshold 0.3: coverage 94%, accuracy when shown 0.800
  - threshold 0.4: coverage 83%, accuracy when shown 0.855
  - threshold 0.5: coverage 68%, accuracy when shown 0.913
  - threshold 0.6: coverage 52%, accuracy when shown 0.952
  - threshold 0.7: coverage 35%, accuracy when shown 0.973

## Held-out test set (group-aware split, evaluated once)

- **full** (n=291): accuracy **0.973**, macro-F1 **0.958**, top-3 0.997; at threshold 0.48: coverage 94.5%, accuracy when shown 0.985; ECE 0.248
